LanguageData.MST.diseaseMtbDaysComment: Average interval in days between disease incidents in this biome. Lower = more frequent.
LanguageData.MST.movementDifficultyComment: Pathfinding cost for caravans crossing tiles of this biome on the world map.
LanguageData.MST.forageabilityComment: Efficiency of foraging food while travelling through this biome.
LanguageData.MST.settlementSelectionWeightComment: Relative weight of this biome being picked for faction settlement sites.
LanguageData.MST.campSelectionWeightComment: Relative weight of this biome being picked for farming camp sites.
LanguageData.MST.pollutionOffsetComment: Initial world-tile pollution offset of this biome at world generation (Biotech pollution).
LanguageData.MST.wildAnimalScariaChanceComment: Chance for wild animals spawned in this biome to have scaria.
LanguageData.MST.geyserCountFactorComment: Multiplier for the number of steam geysers generated on maps of this biome.
LanguageData.MST.maxFishPopulationComment: Maximum fish population sustainable in this biome's waters.
LanguageData.MST.canBuildBaseComment: Whether a player base may be founded in this biome.
LanguageData.MST.canAutoChooseComment: Whether this biome can be auto-picked when choosing a starting site or event sites.
LanguageData.MST.allowRoadsComment: Whether roads may generate in this biome at world generation.
LanguageData.MST.allowRiversComment: Whether rivers may generate in this biome at world generation.
LanguageData.MST.allowPollutionComment: Whether this biome can be polluted.
LanguageData.MST.allowFarmingCampsComment: Whether farming camps may be established in this biome.
LanguageData.MST.wildAnimalsCanWanderIntoComment: Whether wild animals from other biomes may wander into maps of this biome.
LanguageData.MST.wildPlantsCareAboutLocalFertilityCom: Whether wild plant occurrence is affected by local tile fertility.
LanguageData.MST.impassableComment: Whether caravans are completely unable to cross this biome (e.g. oceans).
LanguageData.MST.foragedFoodComment: The food obtained by foraging in this biome.
LanguageData.MST.wildPlantsComment: Wild plants that spawn naturally in this biome and their commonality weights. Some effects require a game restart to apply.
LanguageData.MST.wildAnimalsComment: Wild animals that spawn naturally in this biome and their commonality weights. Some effects require a game restart to apply.
